versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-xiaohongshu-data-collector:

- Provides structured JSON access to public XiaoHongShu (小红书) note data—likes, comments, favorites, note details, and creator posts—without requiring login.
- Supports searching notes by keyword, fetching individual note details and comments, and monitoring creator posts using command-line scripts.
- Includes robust input checks, link type detection, and detailed routing based on user intent (keywords, note links, or profile links).
- Handles errors with clear output structure and status codes, including FAQ for common issues.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable for API access.
- Logs each data request for easy reference and follow-up analysis.
